svg.aria-label: \begin{aligned}\|\mathbf d_0\|=\sqrt5,\quad\|\mathbf q\|=\sqrt2,\quad\cos(\mathbf d_0,\mathbf q)=\frac3{\sqrt5\sqrt2}\approx0.948683\\[5pt]\cos(\mathbf d_2,\mathbf q)=\frac1{\sqrt2},\qquad\cos(10\mathbf d_2,\mathbf q)=\frac{10}{10\sqrt2}=\frac1{\sqrt2}\end{aligned}
